answer: Dawn beacon auction: each fake costs a 30-day frozen deposit plus an entry price doubling per same-cluster join (nth fake pays 2^n). At each epoch's dawn a public random beacon selects entrants who must sign that beacon value with the exact key whose 'tundra' coins paid, and those coins must show 30 days untouched on-ledger. Coins traced within 3 hops to another entrant's payment are rejected. A farm can't reuse one frozen stash across fakes or parallelize the 30-day freeze; it must lock fresh capital per identity. Limit: a rich, patient attacker still can, just slowly.
